# 📦 بسته کامل کدهای پروژه و دادگان سامانهٔ اطلاعات هوافضا `ORBITA`

این سند شامل **کد کامل و سورس تمامی فایل‌های پروژه**، دادگان‌ها، مرزهای برداری و اسکریپت‌های اجرایی به همراه گزارش فنی است.

---

## 🔧 اسکریپت بازسازی خودکار تمامی فایل‌های پروژه (`Auto Unbundler Script`)

```python
import os, json, re

with open("ORBITA_Full_Codebase_Bundle.md", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Scan starting after the unbundler header to avoid self-matching
start_idx = content.find("## 📂 سورس کامل تمام فایل‌های پروژه")
if start_idx != -1:
    body = content[start_idx:]
else:
    body = content

pattern = r"### 📄 فایل: `([^`]+)`\s*```(?:html|css|javascript|json|python|bash)?\n([\s\S]*?)\n```"
matches = re.findall(pattern, body)

for rel_path, code in matches:
    full_path = os.path.join(".", rel_path)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full_path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(full_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        out.write(code)
    print(f"✅ فایل بازسازی شد: {rel_path}")

print("🚀 بازسازی کامل پروژه با موفقیت به پایان رسید!")
```

### 📄 فایل: `serve.py`
```python
import http.server
import socketserver
import os
import socket

PORT = 5173

class FastNoCacheHandler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        # Force browser to never cache stale JS or JSON files under any circumstances
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate, max-age=0')
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')
        self.send_header('Surrogate-Control', 'no-store')
        super().end_headers()

    def handle_one_request(self):
        try:
            super().handle_one_request()
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError, socket.error):
            pass

class ThreadedHTTPServer(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True

if __name__ == '__main__':
    os.chdir('/home/user/spaceapp')
    server = ThreadedHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', PORT), FastNoCacheHandler)
    print(f"ORBITA fast multi-threaded server running on http://0.0.0.0:{PORT}")
    while True:
        try:
            server.serve_forever()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Server error caught: {e}")

```


### 📄 فایل: `assets/css/app.css`
```css
/* ===== ORBITA — theme tokens ===== */
:root[data-theme="navy"]{
  --bg:#0b1524; --bg2:#122237; --panel:rgba(14,27,45,.94); --panel-solid:#0f1e33;
  --row:#0f1f31; --row2:#132639;
  --line:rgba(126,180,235,.16); --text:#e7f0fb; --muted:#8ba3c4;
  --accent:#2fd4a7; --accent-2:#38bdf8; --amber:#f5a524; --violet:#a78bfa; --rose:#fb7185; --green:#34d399;
  --shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
}
:root[data-theme="light"]{
  --bg:#eef3f9; --bg2:#ffffff; --panel:rgba(255,255,255,.96); --panel-solid:#ffffff;
  --row:#ffffff; --row2:#f4f7fc;
  --line:rgba(20,45,85,.13); --text:#14243d; --muted:#5c6f8e;
  --accent:#0f9d76; --accent-2:#0284c7; --amber:#b8730d; --violet:#7c3aed; --rose:#e11d48; --green:#059669;
  --shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(30,50,90,.15);
}

*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
  font-family:Tahoma,"Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:14px}
button,input,select{font-family:inherit;color:inherit}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:9px;height:9px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line);border-radius:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}

/* ===== topbar ===== */
.topbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:56px;z-index:60;display:flex;align-items:center;
  gap:18px;padding:0 16px;background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--accent)}
.logo b{display:block;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:var(--text)}
.logo small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-inline-start:12px}
.tab{background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 16px;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;transition:.15s}
.tab:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2)}
.tab.active{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 13%,transparent)}
.topbar-actions{margin-inline-start:auto;display:flex;gap:8px}
.ghost-btn{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:7px 12px;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:.15s}
.ghost-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}

.view{display:none;position:fixed;inset:56px 0 0 0}
.view.active{display:block}
/* when the launch ticker is showing, push every view down by its height */
body.has-lnch .view{inset:86px 0 0 0}

/* ===== next-launch ticker ===== */
.lnch-bar{position:fixed;top:56px;left:0;right:0;height:30px;z-index:58;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 14px;font-size:11.5px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 16%,var(--panel-solid)),var(--panel-solid) 62%);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.lnch-bar[hidden]{display:none}
.lnch-dot{width:7px;height:7px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 60%,transparent);animation:lnchPulse 2.2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes lnchPulse{
  0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 55%,transparent)}
  70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px transparent}
  100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 transparent}}
.lnch-lbl{color:var(--muted);flex:0 0 auto}
.lnch-name{font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:38vw;min-width:0}
.lnch-name.clickable{cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-style:dotted;
  text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 65%,transparent)}
.lnch-name.clickable:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.lnch-sep{color:var(--muted);flex:0 0 auto}
.lnch-prov{color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:22vw;
  min-width:0;flex:0 1 auto}
.lnch-name bdi,.lnch-prov bdi{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.lnch-cd{margin-inline-start:auto;flex:0 0 auto;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.3px}
.lnch-cd.approx{font-weight:600;color:var(--text);opacity:.9}
.lnch-live{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:21px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:20px;
  text-decoration:none;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:#e0364f;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(224,54,79,.18)}
.lnch-live:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.lnch-live[hidden]{display:none}
.lnch-live i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:lnchPulse 1.4s ease-out infinite}
.lnch-x{flex:0 0 auto;width:20px;height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
  border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;border-radius:5px}
.lnch-x:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2)}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .lnch-lbl,.lnch-sep,.lnch-prov{display:none}
  .lnch-name{max-width:46vw}
}

/* ===== MAP ===== */
#map{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--bg)}
.map-status{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);color:var(--muted);z-index:2}
.coords{position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:12px;z-index:12;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--panel);
  padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;direction:ltr;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;border:1px solid var(--line)}

/* horizontal layer bar — compact, single row */
.layerbar{position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:22;display:flex;gap:6px;
  padding:5px;background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);flex-wrap:nowrap;max-width:calc(100vw - 130px);overflow-x:auto}
.layerbar::-webkit-scrollbar{height:0}
.lchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);font-size:12px;color:var(--text);transition:.15s;
  user-select:none;white-space:nowrap}
.lchip:hover{border-color:currentColor}
.lchip .ic{width:17px;height:17px;flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;place-items:center}
.lchip .lb{display:none}
.lchip .n{font-size:10.5px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:0 6px;color:var(--muted)}
.lchip.off{opacity:.38;filter:grayscale(1)}
@media(min-width:1150px){ .lchip .lb{display:inline} .lchip{padding:6px 12px;font-size:12.5px} }

/* floating search button */
.fab{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;z-index:21;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:var(--muted);
  cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.fab:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.sidebar.open ~ .fab, .fab.hidden{display:none}

.sidebar{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;z-index:24;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
  width:270px;max-height:min(52vh,430px);padding:9px;background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  transition:opacity .18s ease, transform .18s ease}
.sidebar.collapsed{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(-8px) scale(.97)}
.side-top{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}
.search-wrap{flex:1}
.search-wrap input{width:100%;padding:8px 11px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:9px;font-size:12.5px;outline:none}
.search-wrap input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.mini-btn{width:30px;height:30px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--bg2);color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}
.mini-btn:hover{color:var(--rose);border-color:var(--rose)}
.list-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);padding:0 3px}
.result-list{flex:1;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-height:0}
.res{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid transparent;background:var(--bg2);font-size:12px}
.res:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.res .ic{width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 auto}
.res .t{flex:1;min-width:0}
.res .t b{display:block;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.res .t span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}

/* markers */
.pin{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .14s ease;transform-origin:50% 100%;line-height:0}
.pin:hover{transform:scale(1.28)}
.pin svg{display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
.pin.cluster{transform-origin:50% 50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-radius:50%;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:#08131f;line-height:1;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 96%,#fff),var(--cc));
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 26%,transparent),0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.pin.cluster:hover{transform:scale(1.16)}

.maplibregl-popup-content{background:var(--panel-solid);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:11px;padding:11px 30px 11px 13px;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:var(--shadow);line-height:1.7}
.maplibregl-popup-close-button{inset-inline-end:4px;inset-inline-start:auto;top:4px;width:22px;height:22px;
  border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.maplibregl-popup-close-button:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2)}
.maplibregl-ctrl-group{background:var(--panel-solid)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important}
:root[data-theme="navy"] .maplibregl-ctrl-group button span{filter:invert(1) brightness(1.7)}
.maplibregl-ctrl-attrib{background:var(--panel)!important;font-size:10px}
.maplibregl-ctrl-attrib a{color:var(--muted)!important}

/* detail panel */
.detail-panel{position:absolute;top:12px;bottom:12px;left:12px;width:390px;z-index:25;overflow:auto;padding:18px;
  background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);transform:translateX(-115%);transition:transform .28s ease;opacity:0;
  pointer-events:none;visibility:hidden}
.detail-panel.open{transform:none;opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;visibility:visible}
.close-x{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;z-index:3}
.close-x:hover{color:var(--rose);border-color:var(--rose)}

.d-head{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:12px}
.d-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:5px}
.d-title{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 3px}
.d-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);direction:ltr;text-align:right;margin-bottom:12px}
.d-desc{font-size:13px;line-height:2.05;margin-bottom:13px}

/* ---- satellite photo / operator crest ---- */
.sat-photo{margin:0 0 11px;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:var(--bg2);position:relative;line-height:0}
.sat-photo img{width:100%;max-height:210px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;display:block}
.sat-photo figcaption{position:absolute;inset-inline-end:0;inset-block-end:0;font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.6;
  color:#e8eef6;background:rgba(6,12,22,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);padding:2px 7px;
  border-start-start-radius:7px}
.sat-photo.failed{display:none}
.sat-crest{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:11px;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:11px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--crest) 26%,transparent),transparent 78%)}
.sat-crest .crest-mark{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:52px;height:52px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:11px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.5px;
  color:#fff;background:var(--crest);box-shadow:0 3px 12px -3px var(--crest)}
.sat-crest .crest-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.sat-crest .crest-txt small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.4px}
.sat-crest .crest-txt b{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5}
.use-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:11px;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:20px;
  font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--use) 15%,transparent);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--use) 42%,transparent)}
.use-tag i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--use);
  box-shadow:0 0 7px 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--use) 75%,transparent)}
.d-desc.en{direction:ltr;text-align:left;font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.8}
.acc{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:12px;background:var(--bg2)}
.acc summary{cursor:pointer;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--accent);list-style:none}
.acc summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.acc .in{padding:0 12px 12px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-bottom:12px}
.cell{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px}
.cell small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px}
.cell b{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;display:block;word-break:break-word}
.cell.ltr b{direction:ltr;text-align:right}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
.chip{font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;direction:ltr;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 14%,transparent);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,transparent);color:var(--accent)}
.sec-t{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 7px}
.badge{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.b-success,.b-operational{background:rgba(52,211,153,.14);color:#34d399;border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.4)}
.b-upcoming{background:rgba(56,189,248,.14);color:#38bdf8;border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,.4)}
.b-development,.b-cruise,.b-deployment{background:rgba(167,139,250,.14);color:#a78bfa;border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.4)}
.b-partial{background:rgba(245,165,36,.15);color:#f5a524;border:1px solid rgba(245,165,36,.42)}
.b-failure{background:rgba(251,113,133,.14);color:#fb7185;border:1px solid rgba(251,113,133,.42)}
.b-inactive,.b-under_construction,.b-active{background:rgba(139,163,196,.14);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line)}
:root[data-theme="light"] .b-success,:root[data-theme="light"] .b-operational{color:#047857}
:root[data-theme="light"] .b-upcoming{color:#0369a1}
:root[data-theme="light"] .b-development,:root[data-theme="light"] .b-cruise,:root[data-theme="light"] .b-deployment{color:#6d28d9}
:root[data-theme="light"] .b-partial{color:#b45309}
:root[data-theme="light"] .b-failure{color:#be123c}

/* ===== MISSIONS (table layout) ===== */
.missions-wrap{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:auto;padding:16px 20px 40px}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.icon-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);
  color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
.icon-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.tb-select{height:38px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);
  font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;outline:none;max-width:200px}
.tb-select:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.tb-search{flex:1;min-width:220px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:38px;padding:0 12px;
  border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--muted)}
.tb-search input{flex:1;border:0;background:transparent;outline:none;font-size:12.5px}

.tablewrap{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel-solid)}
.thead,.mrow-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,2.1fr) 1fr 1fr 150px 1fr 96px 44px;
  align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px}
.thead{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.thead .col-mission{text-align:right}
.thead span:not(.col-mission){text-align:center}

.mrow{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--row);transition:background .12s}
.mrow:nth-child(even){background:var(--row2)}
.mrow:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 8%,var(--row))}
.mrow-grid{cursor:pointer}
.m-main{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center;min-width:0}
.m-thumb{width:56px;height:42px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.m-txt{min-width:0}
.m-txt .t1{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.m-txt .t2{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);direction:ltr;text-align:right;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:2px}
.m-txt .t3{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--accent-2);direction:rtl;margin-top:3px}
.m-txt .t4{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);opacity:.75;direction:ltr;text-align:right;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.cc{text-align:center;font-size:12px;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cc.two{white-space:normal;line-height:1.5}
.cc small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);direction:ltr}
.orbit-chip{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid;white-space:nowrap;
  max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.exp-btn{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);
  color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.15s;margin:0 auto}
.exp-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.mrow.open .exp-btn{transform:rotate(90deg);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.m-detail{display:none;padding:4px 18px 20px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);background:var(--bg2)}
.mrow.open .m-detail{display:block}
.det-2col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 1fr;gap:18px;padding-top:14px}
.det-2col img{width:100%;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  .thead,.mrow-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,2fr) 1fr 130px 96px 44px}
  .thead .col-op,.thead .col-loc,.mrow .c-op,.mrow .c-loc{display:none}
  .det-2col{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

.upcoming{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:18px}
.up-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:9px}
.up-list{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}
.up-card{flex:0 0 240px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 12px;
  transition:border-color .15s,background .15s}
.up-card.has-pad{cursor:pointer}
.up-card.has-pad:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 55%,transparent);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 9%,transparent)}
.up-pad{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:7px;padding-top:7px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--accent);
  border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.up-pad bdi{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.up-pad svg{flex:0 0 auto}
.up-card b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:4px;direction:ltr;text-align:right}
.up-card span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);direction:ltr;text-align:right}
.up-card .cd{color:var(--amber);font-size:11.5px;margin-top:6px;direction:rtl;text-align:right}
/* ---- curated vs auto-imported rows ---- */
.src-tag{display:inline-block;margin-inline-start:7px;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:20px;font-size:9.5px;
  font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.7}
.src-tag.full{color:#5ee9a5;background:rgba(94,233,165,.13);border:1px solid rgba(94,233,165,.32)}
.src-tag.new{color:#7dd3fc;background:rgba(125,211,252,.13);border:1px solid rgba(125,211,252,.34)}
.src-tag.mega{color:var(--amber);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--amber) 14%,transparent);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--amber) 36%,transparent)}
.mrow.is-live .m-thumb{opacity:.92}
.d-note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:2;padding:9px 11px;margin:2px 0 4px;
  border-radius:9px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px dashed var(--line)}
.mega-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;max-height:250px;overflow:auto}
.mk{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:9px;font-size:11.5px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--bg2)}
.mk-d{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--accent);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:10.5px}
.mk-r{margin-inline-start:auto;flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px}
.ghost-btn.watch{text-decoration:none;color:#fff;background:#e0364f;border-color:#e0364f;
  margin-inline-end:8px;display:inline-flex}
.ghost-btn.watch:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);color:#fff;border-color:#e0364f}

.up-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:8px}
.m-count{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.m-count b{color:var(--accent);font-size:15px}

@media(max-width:820px){
  .sidebar{width:calc(100vw - 24px);left:12px}
  .detail-panel{width:auto;right:12px;top:auto;height:56vh}
  .layerbar{top:auto;bottom:14px;left:12px;transform:none;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px)}
  .fab{top:12px;right:12px}
  .coords{display:none}
  .maplibregl-ctrl-bottom-left{display:none}
}

/* offline base-map country labels */
.clabel{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);opacity:.85;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;
  text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.75);letter-spacing:.3px}
:root[data-theme="light"] .clabel{text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.clabel.r1,.clabel.r2{font-size:12.5px;opacity:1;color:var(--text)}
.clabel.r3{font-size:11.5px}
.clabel.r6,.clabel.r7,.clabel.r8{font-size:10px;opacity:.7}

/* Country dossier action button contrast fixes */
.country-btn-fly {
  background: rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.25) !important;
  color: #38bdf8 !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5) !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.country-btn-fly:hover {
  background: rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.6) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: #38bdf8 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
}

.country-btn-view {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2) !important;
  color: #34d399 !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.5) !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.country-btn-view:hover {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: #34d399 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.4);
}

.country-btn-prop {
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.2) !important;
  color: #fbbf24 !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.5) !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.country-btn-prop:hover {
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.5) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: #fbbf24 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.4);
}

.country-btn-site {
  background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.2) !important;
  color: #f87171 !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.5) !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.country-btn-site:hover {
  background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.5) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: #f87171 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.4);
}
.city-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #8bb8e8;
  opacity: 0.88;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  transform: translate(12px, 8px);
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}
:root[data-theme="light"] .city-label {
  color: #1b3d68;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}
.city-label.r1 {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #a8d2f7;
}

/* ===== ORBIT (3D) VIEW ===== */
#globe{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#03060d;touch-action:none;cursor:grab}
#globe:active{cursor:grabbing}
#globe canvas{display:block}
.globe-loading{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;background:#03060d;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;z-index:12}
.globe-loading.hidden{display:none}
.spin{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--line);border-top-color:var(--accent);
  animation:sp 900ms linear infinite}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

.orb-toolbar{position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:20;display:flex;gap:8px;
  align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;padding:7px 9px;background:var(--panel);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  max-width:calc(100vw - 40px)}
.orb-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:32px;padding:0 11px;border-radius:9px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--muted);min-width:150px;flex:0 1 190px}
.orb-search input{border:0;background:transparent;outline:none;font-size:12.5px;width:100%}
.orb-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:0 11px;height:32px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.orb-toggle input{accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}

/* density segmented control */
.orb-seg{display:flex;align-items:stretch;height:32px;padding:2px;gap:2px;border-radius:10px;
  background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.orb-seg .seg-b{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:100%;padding:0 10px;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:background .15s,color .15s}
.orb-seg .seg-b:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 12%,transparent);color:var(--text)}
.orb-seg .seg-b.active{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 20%,transparent);color:var(--text);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,transparent)}
.orb-seg .seg-n{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);opacity:.85;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 55%,transparent);border-radius:5px;padding:1px 5px}
.orb-seg .seg-b.active .seg-n{color:var(--accent);opacity:1}
.orb-count{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:0 6px;white-space:nowrap}
.orb-count b{color:var(--accent);font-size:14px}

.orb-btn{position:absolute;top:50px;inset-inline-start:14px;z-index:24;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:30px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;
  font:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;color:#08131f;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 74%,#7dd3fc));
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 70%,#fff);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 18%,transparent),0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  transition:filter .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.orb-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 26%,transparent),0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.orb-btn.on{filter:brightness(.92);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 30%,transparent)}
.orb-btn svg{color:#08131f;flex:0 0 auto}

/* ---- pass prediction panel ---- */
.pass-panel{position:absolute;top:88px;inset-inline-start:14px;width:336px;max-height:calc(100% - 124px);z-index:28;
  display:none;flex-direction:column;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(15px);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.pass-panel.open{display:flex}
.pass-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px}
.pass-head .close-x{position:static;width:24px;height:24px;font-size:13px}
.pass-loc{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:10px 12px 8px}
.pass-input{position:relative;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:31px;padding:0 10px;
  border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--muted)}
.pass-input input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;outline:none;font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--text)}
.mini-btn{width:31px;height:31px;flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
  border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--accent)}
.mini-btn:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 15%,transparent)}
.city-list{position:absolute;top:34px;inset-inline-start:0;width:100%;max-height:212px;overflow:auto;z-index:5;
  display:none;border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel-solid);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.city-list.open{display:block}
.city-list .ci{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}
.city-list .ci:hover,.city-list .ci.sel{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 14%,transparent)}
.city-list .ci small{color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px;margin-inline-start:auto}
.pass-opts{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 12px 9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mini-tg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
.mini-tg input{accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}
.mini-sel{height:27px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:7px;font:inherit;font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-inline-start:auto}
.pass-where{padding:0 12px 9px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.pass-where b{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.pass-body{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:0 9px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.pass-empty{padding:16px 10px;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.9}
.pcard{padding:9px 10px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);
  transition:border-color .14s,background .14s}
.pcard:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 50%,transparent);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 9%,transparent)}
.pcard .p1{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:5px}
.pcard .p1 b{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.pcard .eye{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:9.5px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:600;
  color:#0b1a10;background:#5ee9a5}
.pcard .p2{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.pcard .p2 b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.pcard .bar{margin-top:6px;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 70%,transparent);overflow:hidden}
.pcard .bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:3px;background:var(--pc,#2fd4a7)}
.pass-note{padding:7px 10px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;line-height:1.8}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .pass-panel{inset-inline:10px;width:auto;top:auto;bottom:10px;max-height:62vh}
}

.orb-legend{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:14px;z-index:20;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;
  padding:9px 11px;background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-size:11.5px}
.lg-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;padding:2px 3px;border-radius:6px}
.lg-row:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 10%,transparent)}
.lg-row.off{opacity:.35}
.lg-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;box-shadow:0 0 8px 1px currentColor}
.lg-row .lg-n{color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px;margin-inline-start:auto}

.orb-hint{position:absolute;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;z-index:18;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:5px 10px;max-width:44vw}

.live-box{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.live-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:12px;padding:3px 0}
.live-row span{color:var(--muted)}
.live-row b{unicode-bidi:isolate;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--accent);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cell b{unicode-bidi:isolate}

#satPanel{left:auto;right:12px}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .orb-hint{display:none}
  .orb-legend{bottom:10px;left:10px;padding:7px 9px}
  .orb-toolbar{top:8px;gap:6px;padding:6px}
  .orb-search{min-width:150px}
  #satPanel{right:10px;left:10px;width:auto;height:52vh;top:auto}
}

/* ================= LAUNCH SITES STABILIZED UI (CATEGORY 1) ================= */
.site-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-top: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.site-tab-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--muted);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  font-family: inherit;
}
.site-tab-btn:hover {
  color: var(--text);
}
.site-tab-btn.active {
  color: var(--accent);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
}
.site-tab-content {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}
.site-tab-content.active {
  display: flex;
}
.site-metrics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.site-metric-card {
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.site-metric-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; right: 0; left: 0; height: 2px;
  background: var(--accent, #38bdf8);
}
.site-metric-card.gold::before { background: #f59e0b; }
.site-metric-card.green::before { background: #10b981; }

.site-metric-card .val {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text);
  margin: 2px 0;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.site-metric-card .lbl {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.site-chart-box {
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px;
}
.site-chart-head {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}
.site-chart-bars {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 70px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.site-bar-col {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}
.site-bar-fill {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(0deg, var(--line) 0%, var(--accent) 100%);
  border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 4px;
}
.site-bar-val {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #fff;
  position: absolute;
  top: -14px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.site-bar-lbl {
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--muted);
  direction: ltr;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.site-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  max-height: 240px;
}
.site-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 11px;
  text-align: right;
}
.site-table th {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 60%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent);
  padding: 6px 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.site-table td {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 40%, transparent);
  color: var(--text);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.badge-ok {
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: bold;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18);
  color: #34d399;
}
.badge-fail {
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: bold;
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.18);
  color: #f87171;
}
.site-filter-sel {
  background: var(--bg2);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  outline: none;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.badge-constr {
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: bold;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18);
  color: #f59e0b;
}

/* Company & Agency Module Styling */
.badge-gov {
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
  color: #38bdf8;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
}
.badge-private {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
  color: #f59e0b;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
}
.badge-public {
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  color: #10b981;
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
}

.site-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}

.site-tab-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.site-tab-btn:hover {
  color: var(--text);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.site-tab-btn.active {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
}

.site-tab-content {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.site-tab-content.active {
  display: flex;
}


/* ==========================================================================
   Mobile Responsive Optimizations (@media max-width: 768px)
   ========================================================================== */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .topbar {
    padding: 6px 10px !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  }
  
  .topbar-brand {
    font-size: 15px !important;
  }
  
  .topbar-nav {
    overflow-x: auto !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
    padding-bottom: 2px !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  
  .topbar-nav .nav-link,
  .topbar-nav .btn {
    font-size: 11px !important;
    padding: 4px 8px !important;
  }
  
  .topbar-actions {
    gap: 4px !important;
  }
  
  .ghost-btn {
    font-size: 11px !important;
    padding: 3px 6px !important;
  }

  .launch-ticker, #tickerBar {
    font-size: 10.5px !important;
    padding: 4px 8px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
  }

  .category-bar, .overlay-filter-bar {
    bottom: 12px !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    transform: translateX(-50%) !important;
    max-width: 95vw !important;
    padding: 4px 8px !important;
    gap: 6px !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
  }
  
  .category-item, .filter-chip {
    padding: 3px 6px !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
  }

  #detail, .detail-drawer, .side-panel {
    width: 100vw !important;
    max-width: 100vw !important;
  }
  
  .country-dossier {
    padding: 12px 14px !important;
  }
}
```
